notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Angels that have flying.
description:
Cast Sephara by paying {W} and tapping four Angels with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sephara, adding {W}.
When Sephara dies, Enduring Renewal and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Sephara from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Angels.
Repeat.
